description: Type pwd on the on-screen keyboard using injected uinput taps; the physical terminal prints /home/shell, then the keyboard is dismissed.
provenance_note: Operator-declared metadata does not prove that footage shows a real touch.

site_assets.video_transform: 180 degree rotation and full-to-limited range conversion; original camera clip retained
site_assets.screenshot_source: grim on the physical board, transferred over serial

review.video_probe: H.264, yuv420p, limited range, 1920x1080, 30 fps, 22.000 seconds, 660 frames
review.visual_review: Reviewed frames near 1, 11, and 20 seconds: the camera shows the portrait terminal with pwd output and the top touch controls; camera glare crosses the upper controls and softens the text. Use screen.png for readable terminal output and keyboard.png for the keyboard layout.
review.interaction_state: Injected uinput taps typed pwd and dismissed the keyboard; the camera clip proves the physical panel display, not a real finger touch.
